messages.subject: 文字探勘
parts:
出現以下錯誤
麻煩各位大師協助指導如何解決
> library(Rwordseg)
Loading required package: rJava
Error : .onLoad failed in loadNamespace() for 'rJava', details:
  call: inDL(x, as.logical(local), as.logical(now), ...)
  error: unable to load shared object 'C:/Users/user/Documents/R/win-library/3.2/rJava/libs/x64/rJava.dll':
  LoadLibrary failure:  %1 不是有效的 Win32 應用程式。

Error: package ‘rJava’ could not be loaded
> library(tm)
Error in loadNamespace(i, c(lib.loc, .libPaths()), versionCheck = vI[[i]]) : 
  there is no package called ‘slam’
Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘tm’
> library(tmcn)  
Error in library(tmcn) : ‘tmcn’ is not a valid installed package
> library(rjson)
Error in library(rjson) : there is no package called ‘rjson’
> library(tm)
Error in loadNamespace(i, c(lib.loc, .libPaths()), versionCheck = vI[[i]]) : 
  there is no package called ‘slam’
Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘tm’
> segmentCN("今天一直下雨")
Error: could not find function "segmentCN"

messages.subject: Re: 文字探勘
parts:
library(Rwordseg): 建議刪除電腦JAVA(如果有得的話)，然後安裝最新版的JAVA(https://www.java.com/)，版本必須配合R，例如執行64位元的R就裝64位元的JAVA，安裝好後再install.packages("rJava")
library(tm): there is no package called ‘slam’ 沒安裝
library(rjson): there is no package called ‘rjson’ 沒安裝
library(tm): there is no package called ‘slam’ 沒安裝
library(tmcn): ‘tmcn’ is not a valid installed package 沒裝好
